updates.evidence: Coveted Falcon says "you own but don't control" (conjunction, not disjunction); Focus Fire says "creatures and/or Spacecraft" (disjunction, not conjunction); Herigast says "Each creature spell you cast" (not Saga); Providence of Night says "with hybrid mana in its mana cost" (monocolored hybrid cards like {2/W} qualify without ColorCount > 1).

updates.summary: Restore missing Not negation on Fastbond and non-mana activated ability triggers
updates.evidence: Fastbond says "if it wasn't the first land you played this turn" and Battlemage's Bracers, Harsh Mentor, Illusionist's Bracers, Kurkesh, Onakke Ancient, and Rings of Brighthearth all say "if it isn't a mana ability", whereas MTGish gold omitted Not(...) and encoded the positive predicate.

updates.summary: Use strict Less comparison for "fewer than" and "lesser mana value"
updates.evidence: Vraska, Betrayal's Sting says "fewer than nine poison counters" and Scrap Trawler says "with lesser mana value", both strict inequalities (<), whereas MTGish gold encoded LessOrEqual (<=).

updates.summary: Correct event-player and villainous-choice actor bindings
updates.evidence: Glimmervoid Basin, Overabundance, Blood Clock, Fraying Line, and Infernal Genesis explicitly refer to the triggering player ("that player", "they"), not AbilityController; Great Intelligence's Plan says "or you may cast a spell from your hand", assigning decider/actor/hand to AbilityController rather than Target(0).

updates.summary: Correct object reference identities in damage, pump, granted upkeep cost, hexproof, exchange, and Coin of Fate
updates.evidence: Jilt and Orim's Thunder deal damage from the spell (Source), not Target(0); Ent's Fury pumps Target(0) before fighting Target(1); granted upkeep abilities on Essence Leak and Disruption Aura reference their own holder (Source); Tam grants hexproof from each affected creature's own colors (Affected); Cultural Exchange swaps Selected(0) and Selected(1); Coin of Fate returns Unselected(0).

updates.summary: Correct trigger scope, timing conditions, and turn/combat durations
updates.evidence: Elesh Norn suppresses abilities controlled by opponents for any entering permanent; Canyon Vaulter and Reckless Velocitaur trigger only during your main phase; Tifa checks first combat phase of your turn; Ria Ivor lasts EndOfCombat ("this combat"); Valiant Farewell's delayed trigger expires EndOfTurn ("this turn").

updates.summary: Restore optionality, up-to/any-number counts, disjunction cost, and suspend guard
updates.evidence: Capricopian ("may reselect"), Trade Secrets ("draw up to four"), Worldpurge ("up to seven"), Expose the Culprit ("any number of"), Expedited Inheritance ("may exile"), Hag of Ceaseless Torment ("sacrifices ... or discards"), Taigam ("If it doesn't have suspend"), and Heroes' Hangout (unconditional play permission without spurious empty PayCost) all directly contradict the MTGish export.

updates.summary: Correct Opal-Eye RedirectDamage, Arvinox AnyColor spend_as, and Soundwave Legendary tokens
updates.evidence: Opal-Eye redirects damage to itself rather than preventing it; Arvinox grants "spend mana as though it were mana of any color"; Soundwave explicitly creates legendary Ravage and legendary Laserbeak tokens.

updates.summary: Restore omitted Not negation on Dose of Dawnglow, Wilhelt, Desynchronization, and undamaged hexproof guards
updates.evidence: Dose of Dawnglow ("if it isn't your main phase"), Wilhelt ("if it didn't have decayed"), Desynchronization ("not historic"), and Karakyk Guardian/Oyaminartok/Palladia-Mors ("as long as it hasn't dealt damage yet") are all negated in Oracle text, whereas MTGish gold omitted Not(...).

updates.summary: Restore omitted filter predicates (Modified, non-self, Land, Creature, ControlledBy, FaceDown, and Extreme population)
updates.evidence: Oracle text explicitly requires modified (Lethal Throwdown), non-self/second target (The Peregrine Dynamo, Tidus), Land/Creature type (Monument to Perfection, Zinnia, Might Makes Right), ControlledBy(You) (Minas Tirith Garrison, Orphans of the Wheat), FaceDown (Spy Network), and among all permanents they control (Dispersal).

updates.evidence: The Argent Etchings says "Incubate 2 five times" (times=5, amount=2) and Glistening Dawn says "Incubate X twice, where X is the number of lands you control" (times=2, amount=land count), whereas MTGish swapped the two operands.

updates.summary: Correct player scope and controller bindings (Kynaios, Okaun, Zndrsplt, Otaria, Death in Heaven, Reality Shift, Barroom Brawl, Jhoira)
updates.evidence: Oracle text specifies opponents (Kynaios), any player (Okaun, Zndrsplt, Otaria), under your control (Death in Heaven), target controller's library (Reality Shift), opponent to your left (Barroom Brawl), and You lose life (Jhoira).

updates.summary: Restore activation timing restrictions and up-to-one mode minimum 0
updates.evidence: Blighted Nightmare says "Activate only as a sorcery"; Katara says "Activate only during your turn"; Hama says "during your turn"; Ravager Wurm and Dreamshackle Geist say "choose up to one" (minimum 0, not 1).

updates.summary: Correct unless-cost disjunctions, Emissary's Ploy choice 2, and Michelangelo OneForEach constraint
updates.evidence: Perforating Artist and Polygraph Orb offer an OR choice between sacrificing and discarding; Emissary's Ploy says "choose 1, 2, or 3" (gold omitted 2); Michelangelo says "a creature card and/or a land card" (at most one of each, not two lands or two creatures).

updates.summary: Fix otherwise branch scoping, suspend guard, and missing player protection on Faith's Shield
updates.evidence: Amy's Home checks "If it doesn't have suspend"; Bre of Clan Stoutarm and Guidelight Pathmaker say "Otherwise, put it into your hand"; Faith's Shield grants protection to "you and each permanent you control" at 5 or less life.

updates.summary: Fix Volo CreatureTypes check, Volcano Hellion unpreventable damage, Coram land+spell permissions, and Sleuth Instructor single trigger
updates.evidence: Volo tests creature types rather than colors; Volcano Hellion says "The damage can't be prevented"; Coram permits both playing a land AND casting a spell each turn; Sleuth Instructor is one ability with "This ability triggers only once."

updates.summary: Preserve 'for as long as you control this creature' controller condition instead of WhileOnBattlefield
updates.evidence: Oracle text for Aegis Angel, Kyodai, Soul of Kamigawa, and Thancred Waters states 'gains indestructible for as long as you control [self]'; frozen gold emitted WhileOnBattlefield(Source) without the controller check.

updates.summary: Execute 'Tap target creature.' unconditionally before metalcraft exile on Dispatch
updates.evidence: Dispatch reads 'Tap target creature. If you control three or more artifacts, exile that creature.'; frozen gold placed SetTapped only in the otherwise branch, failing to tap before exiling when metalcraft is active.

updates.summary: Include 'that player controls' on Mordant Dragon's combat-damage trigger target
updates.evidence: Mordant Dragon reads 'deal that much damage to target creature that player controls.'; frozen gold omitted ControlledBy(EventSubject), permitting targeting any creature.

updates.summary: Use Affected exclusion and Creature blocker filter on Nephilim Epochal
updates.evidence: Nephilim Epochal reads 'Nephilim you control get +1/+1 for each other Nephilim you control and can't be blocked by monocolored creatures.'; frozen gold excluded Source instead of Affected and omitted CardType(Creature) on the blocker filter.

updates.summary: Normalize 'third from the top' library position to Constant(3) on Teferi, Hero of Dominaria
updates.evidence: Teferi's [-3] reads 'Put target nonland permanent into its owner's library third from the top.'; frozen gold emitted unsimplified Add(Constant(2), Constant(1)) instead of Constant(3).

updates.summary: Fix Sarulf, Realm Eater mana value comparison from Less to LessOrEqual
updates.evidence: Sarulf, Realm Eater says "exile each other nonland permanent with mana value less than or equal to the number of counters removed this way" (Comparison::LessOrEqual), whereas MTGish exported Comparison::Less.

updates.summary: Restore AddCurrentAbility copy exception on Court of Vantress
updates.evidence: Court of Vantress says "you may have this enchantment become a copy of it, except it has this ability" (CopyException::AddCurrentAbility), whereas MTGish exported an empty exceptions list.

updates.summary: Restore SharesNameWith predicate on Legion's End battlefield exile clause
updates.evidence: Legion's End says "all other creatures that player controls with the same name as that creature", whereas MTGish omitted SharesNameWith(Target(0, 0)) from the battlefield permanent filter.

updates.summary: Fix swapped Repeat.times and Incubate.amount on Progenitor Exarch
updates.evidence: Progenitor Exarch says "When this creature enters, incubate 3 X times" (times=CastX(EventSubject), amount=Constant(3)), whereas MTGish swapped the two operands (same upstream bug fixed on The Argent Etchings and Glistening Dawn in U0099).

updates.summary: Restore CardType(Creature) on Malik, Grim Manipulator secret choice pool
updates.evidence: Malik, Grim Manipulator says "you and target opponent each secretly choose a creature that player controls", whereas MTGish omitted CardType(Creature) from the choice-pool filter.

updates.summary: Restore CardType(Land) on Tunnel Ignus intervening-if entry history filter
updates.evidence: Tunnel Ignus says "if that player had another land enter the battlefield under their control this turn", whereas MTGish omitted CardType(Land) from the historical ZoneChange object filter. PlayerRef::EventSubject correctly names the opponent under whose control the triggering land entered.

updates.summary: Restrict Chandra's Phoenix planeswalker damage trigger recipients to opponents
updates.evidence: Chandra's Phoenix says "Whenever an opponent is dealt damage by a red instant or sorcery spell you control or by a red planeswalker you control", so both branches require opponent recipients (OpponentsOf(AbilityController)), whereas MTGish exported Players(All) on the planeswalker branch.

updates.summary: Negate Thirsting Axe end-step combat-damage intervening-if predicate
updates.evidence: Thirsting Axe says "At the beginning of your end step, if equipped creature didn't deal combat damage to a creature this turn, sacrifice it", whereas MTGish exported the unnegated >= 1 occurrence check.

updates.summary: Model Vhati il-Dal power-or-toughness resolution choice as ChooseOne
updates.evidence: Vhati il-Dal says "Until end of turn, target creature has base power 1 or base toughness 1" (a resolution-time choice between SetPower(1) and SetToughness(1)), whereas MTGish unconditionally applied both SetPower(1) and SetToughness(1).

updates.summary: Move Gilded Ambusher damage inside ForEachPlayer targeting each opponent (Bound(0))
updates.evidence: Gilded Ambusher says "each opponent exiles a nonland, nontoken permanent they control and a random nonland card from their library, then Gilded Ambusher deals damage to them equal to the total mana value of the cards exiled this way", whereas MTGish placed DealDamage outside the opponent loop with recipient AbilityController instead of Bound(0) inside the loop.

updates.summary: Fix Urge to Feed counter placement to put one +1/+1 counter on each tapped Vampire
updates.evidence: Urge to Feed says "You may tap any number of untapped Vampire creatures you control. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those Vampires", whereas MTGish put CountObjects(tapped) counters on Target(0, 0) instead of 1 counter on each tapped Vampire (Transition(result=2, phase=Before)).

updates.summary: Fix Urza, Lord Protector meld condition filter from Creature to Artifact
updates.evidence: Urza, Lord Protector says "If you both own and control Urza, Lord Protector and an artifact named The Mightstone and Weakstone", and the exile choice already filters by CardType(Artifact), whereas MTGish exported CardType(Creature) in the condition.

updates.summary: Run Hex, Kellan's Companion's battlefield exile check after the perpetual pump instead of inside the non-battlefield branch.
updates.evidence: Hex, Kellan's Companion says "if Hex is on the battlefield or in exile, it perpetually gets +1/+1. Then if it's on the battlefield, exile it with a fetch counter on it." The frozen export split on InZone(Battlefield) and placed the follow-up If(InZone(Battlefield), Move(Exile)) inside the otherwise branch (not on the battlefield), making the exile dead code when Hex is on the battlefield.

updates.summary: Allow Yuna's Decision's first mode to put up to one creature card and/or one land card from hand onto the battlefield via OneForEach.
updates.evidence: Yuna's Decision's first mode says "you may put a creature card and/or a land card from your hand onto the battlefield." The frozen export used ChooseObjects with count AsManyAsCan(1) and no constraints, allowing only one card total rather than up to one creature card and up to one land card. Match Michelangelo, Improviser (U0102) using WithSelections with UpTo(2) and OneForEach([CardType(Creature), CardType(Land)]).

updates.summary: Use CreatureTypeWord vocabulary operands in Artificial Evolution's ReplaceWord instead of ColorWord.
updates.evidence: Artificial Evolution says "Change the text of target spell or permanent by replacing all instances of one creature type with another. The new creature type can't be Wall." Both implied modes correctly choose two CreatureTypes (except Wall), but their ReplaceWord operands erroneously referenced ColorWord::TheFirstChosenColorWord / ColorWord::TheSecondChosenColorWord instead of CreatureTypeWord::TheFirstChosenCreatureType / CreatureTypeWord::TheSecondChosenCreatureType (paralleling LandTypeWord::TheFirstChosenLandType / TheSecondChosenLandType on Magical Hack and Spectral Shift).

updates.summary: Reveal the drafted card (result 3) rather than the earlier hand reveal (result 0) on Break Expectations.
updates.evidence: Break Expectations says "If a card was exiled this way, that player drafts a card from Break Expectations's spellbook and reveals it." The frozen export referenced Recorded(0) (the cards revealed from the target player's hand in instruction 0) instead of Recorded(3) (the card drafted in instruction 3).

updates.summary: Enforce OneForEach([Subtype(Saga), CardType(Land)]) on Eivor, Wolf-Kissed's milled-card entry choice.
updates.evidence: Eivor, Wolf-Kissed says "You may put a Saga card and/or a land card from among them onto the battlefield." The frozen export used UpTo(2) with empty constraints over AnyOf([Saga, Land]), permitting two Sagas or two lands. Match Michelangelo, Improviser (U0102) with OneForEach([Subtype(Saga), CardType(Land)]) over Recorded(0).

updates.summary: Guard Enigma Sphinx Avatar's bottom-of-library placement with If(Not(PaymentChosen)) on the optional free play.
updates.evidence: Enigma Sphinx Avatar says "You may play that card without paying its mana cost. If you don't, put that card on the bottom of your library." The frozen export placed an unconditional ReorderLibrary after PlayCards with no conditional branch. Wrap the optional PlayCards in PayCost(optional:true, PlayerAction) and guard ReorderLibrary with If(Not(PaymentChosen(1))), matching Breaching Dragonstorm, Chandra, Torch of Defiance, and Vaan, Street Thief.

updates.summary: Enforce OneForEach across mana values 1, 2, and 3 on Gruesome Menagerie.
updates.evidence: Gruesome Menagerie says "Choose a creature card with mana value 1 in your graveyard, then do the same for creature cards with mana value 2 and 3. Return those cards to the battlefield." The frozen export used UpTo(3) with empty constraints over AnyOf([MV 1, MV 2, MV 3]), permitting multiple cards of the same mana value. Enforce OneForEach across the three filters over Zone(Graveyard, Any).

updates.summary: Restore CardType(Creature) and ControlledBy(One(Bound(0))) to Highcliff Felidar's greatest-power selection filter.
updates.evidence: Highcliff Felidar says "for each opponent, choose a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls. Destroy those creatures." The frozen export's ChooseObjects filter checked only Power == Maximum(...) and omitted both CardType(Creature) and ControlledBy(One(Bound(0))), allowing selection of permanents controlled by other players. Match Summon: Valefor's per-player maximum ChooseObjects filter.

updates.summary: Check Observed(0) instead of recounting the opponent's post-discard hand on Mind Spike.
updates.evidence: Mind Spike says "Target opponent reveals each noncreature, nonland card in their hand. You choose a card revealed this way. That player discards that card. You lose 2 life. If they didn't reveal a card this way, you draw a card." The frozen export counted current noncreature, nonland cards in the opponent's hand after the discard, causing a draw whenever the opponent had revealed and discarded their sole matching card. Count Observed(0) from the Reveal instruction instead.

updates.summary: Include all four chosen permanents (results 0, 2, 4, 6) in Nature Demands an Offering's shuffle player filter.
updates.evidence: Nature Demands an Offering says "target opponent chooses a creature you don't control and puts it on top of its owner's library, then repeats this process for an artifact, an enchantment, and a land. Then the owner of each permanent chosen this way shuffles." The frozen export checked only Recorded(6) (the land), omitting the chosen creature (0), artifact (2), and enchantment (4). Union all four Recorded receipts.

updates.summary: Count nonland cards exiled across all three Repeatable exile steps (results 0, 1, 2) on Rally the Horde.
updates.evidence: Rally the Horde exiles the top card of your library three times per iteration, repeats if the third isn't a land, then creates a 1/1 red Warrior token "for each nonland card exiled this way." The frozen export counted only Transition(result: 2, After), dropping cards exiled by steps 0 and 1. Union Transition(0, After), Transition(1, After), and Transition(2, After).

updates.summary: Put Retribution's -1/-1 counter on the unsacrificed target creature via Difference(Targets(0), Transition(0, Before)).
updates.evidence: Retribution says "Choose two target creatures controlled by the same opponent. That player chooses and sacrifices one of those creatures. Put a -1/-1 counter on the other." The frozen export put counters on Targets(0) (both targets) rather than Difference(Targets(0), Transition(result: 0, phase: Before)).

updates.summary: Exile the top card of the playing player (Affected) library rather than AbilityController on Share the Spoils.
updates.evidence: Share the Spoils reads "During each player's turn, that player may play a land or cast a spell from among cards exiled with this enchantment ... When they do, exile the top card of their library." The static effect affects Players(All) and already uses One(Affected) for during; frozen gold wrongly used One(AbilityController) for the library owner in the triggered effect.

updates.summary: Grant suspend to both cards exiled by Sinister Concierge (self cost and target) that do not already have suspend.
updates.evidence: Sinister Concierge reads "you may exile it and put three time counters on it. If you do, exile up to one target creature and put three time counters on it. If you search your library this way, put this creature on the bottom of its owner's library, then shuffle." In the PlayerIsActive otherwise branch (not your turn), frozen gold ran only ReorderLibrary on all Observed(0) cards and dropped moving Selected(1) into hand.

updates.summary: Restrict Itazura, Lingering Wick hand choice to exiled cards still in Exile (not cast this way).
updates.evidence: Itazura, Lingering Wick reads "they may cast a spell from among those cards without paying its mana cost. You put a card from among them that wasn't cast this way into your hand." Frozen gold selected from all Transition(0, After) without excluding the cast card; wrapping with InZone(..., Exile) selects only the cards remaining in exile after the optional cast.

updates.summary: Require target player to be an opponent before drawing a card on Lucy MacLean, Positively Armed.
updates.evidence: Lucy MacLean, Positively Armed reads "you may have target player other than its controller create a token that's a copy of it, then you draw a card if an opponent created a token this way." Frozen gold checked only PaymentChosen(0), wrongly drawing when AbilityController targeted themselves after an opponent's token entered.

updates.summary: Restore target opponent hand Reveal before PlayWith on Mindclaw Shaman
updates.evidence: Mindclaw Shaman reads 'When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among those cards without paying its mana cost.'; frozen gold dropped the Reveal instruction entirely and queried the unrevealed hand directly.

updates.summary: Scope each player's Fractal token creation and +1/+1 counter placement together on Oversimplify
updates.evidence: Oversimplify reads 'Exile all creatures. Each player creates a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token and puts a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the total power of creatures they controlled that were exiled this way.'; frozen gold created all players' tokens first and then had each player put counters on every token in Recorded(1) instead of only their own created token.

updates.summary: Select up to two lands for the battlefield tapped before moving the remaining land to hand on Viewpoint Synchronization
updates.evidence: Viewpoint Synchronization reads 'Search your library for up to three basic land cards and reveal them. Put two of them onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.'; frozen gold chose AsManyAsCan(1) for the hand first and moved the rest to the battlefield, putting a card into hand instead of onto the battlefield whenever two or fewer cards are found.

updates.summary: Guard Breeches, the Blastmaker's coin flip and reflexive triggers on paying the optional artifact sacrifice
updates.evidence: Breeches, the Blastmaker reads 'you may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, flip a coin. When you win the flip, ... When you lose the flip, ...'; frozen gold executed FlipCoin and both reflexive triggers unconditionally after the optional PayCost without If(PaymentChosen(0)).

updates.summary: Select a contested land controlled by the damaged player instead of the attacking creature's controller on Turf War
updates.evidence: Turf War reads 'Whenever a creature deals combat damage to a player, if that player controls one or more lands with contested counters on them, that creature's controller gains control of one of those lands of their choice and untaps it.'; frozen gold filtered ChooseObjects by ControlledBy(ControllerOf(Damage(Source))) instead of ControlledBy(EventSubject).

updates.summary: Place Unexpected Results' self-return inside the optional land-card branch guarded by revealing a land
updates.evidence: Unexpected Results reads 'If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield and return Unexpected Results to its owner's hand.' Per Oracle rulings, returning Unexpected Results is part of the optional choice and does not occur if declined or if the library is empty; frozen gold placed Move(Source, OwnersHand) unconditionally in otherwise outside Optional.

updates.summary: Grant free-cast permission to the exiled nonland card rather than the first exiled card on Nicol Bolas, God-Pharaoh and Stolen Goods
updates.evidence: Both faces read 'Target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card. Until end of turn, you may cast that card without paying its mana cost.'; frozen gold emitted Result(1, After, 0) (the first exiled card, a land whenever lands are exiled before the nonland card) instead of Matching(Transition(1, After), Not(CardType(Land))).

updates.summary: Fix lost enchant ability domain (graveyard creature card) and delayed sacrifice controller (reanimated creature's controller) on Animate Dead
updates.evidence: Animate Dead loses 'enchant creature card in a graveyard' (not battlefield permanent) and its delayed trigger makes 'that creature's controller' (ControllerOf(Result(1, After, 0))) sacrifice it, not the Aura's controller (ControllerOf(EventSubject)).

updates.summary: Measure Equipment's own mana value (Source) instead of equipped creature's (Affected) in Bludgeon Brawl's granted pump
updates.evidence: Bludgeon Brawl grants '"Equipped creature gets +X/+0," where X is that artifact's mana value.' Inside the granted static ability, Source is the Equipment artifact and Affected is the equipped creature; frozen gold emitted ObjectProperty(object: Affected, property: ManaValue).

updates.summary: Take cards from the damaged player's library and put them onto the battlefield under AbilityController's control on Cybership
updates.evidence: Cybership reads 'Whenever this Vehicle deals combat damage to a player, put the top two cards of that player's library onto the battlefield face down under your control.'; frozen gold took from AbilityController's library and put them onto the battlefield under Owner's control.

updates.summary: Modal abilities reading 'choose up to one' permit choosing zero modes (minimum 0, not 1).
updates.evidence: Oracle text for Satsuki, the Living Lore, Ertai Resurrected, Hullbreaker Horror, Ravager Wurm, and Dreamshackle Geist reads 'choose up to one —'; frozen gold set ModeCount.minimum to 1 instead of 0.

updates.summary: Retain original Target reference for post-destroy controller draw on Ertai Resurrected.
updates.evidence: Ertai Resurrected's second mode reads 'Destroy another target creature or planeswalker. Its controller draws a card.' Per SPEC.md (post-destroy references retain the original target even if destruction fails) and peer cards (Cleansing Wildfire, Faller's Faithful, Geomancer's Gambit, Ob Nixilis, the Hate-Twisted, Price of Freedom), the draw actor is ControllerOf(Target(0, 0)), not Result(0, Before).

updates.summary: Preserve player-owner, graveyard-owner, and controller scopes on Rootcoil Creeper, Great Intelligence's Plan, and Death in Heaven.
updates.evidence: Rootcoil Creeper restricts mana to spells cast from your graveyard (One(AbilityController), not All); Great Intelligence's Plan's second villainous-choice option ('or you may cast a spell from your hand') has decider, actor, and hand owner AbilityController rather than Target(0); Death in Heaven's chapter III returns cards 'under your control' (Player(AbilityController), not Owner).

updates.summary: Preserve BasePower/BaseToughness checks on Angelic Aberration and NotEqual comparison on Iridian Maelstrom.
updates.evidence: Angelic Aberration specifies 'each with base power or toughness 1 or less' (BasePower/BaseToughness, not Power/Toughness); Iridian Maelstrom specifies 'that isn't all colors' (NotEqual, not Equal).

updates.summary: Preserve explicit CardType(Creature) and controller predicates on High Score, Primal Empathy, Éomer of the Riddermark, Disciples of the Inferno, Shaun, Father of Synths, Szat's Will, and Minas Tirith Garrison.
updates.evidence: High Score, Primal Empathy, and Éomer of the Riddermark test controlling a creature with greatest power (preserving CardType(Creature)); Disciples of the Inferno restricts damage sources to 'you control'; Shaun, Father of Synths targets a creature 'you control' (One(AbilityController), not OthersThan); Szat's Will exiles all opponents' graveyards (OpponentsOf scope with filter Any) and counts only creature cards exiled this way; Minas Tirith Garrison taps untapped Humans 'you control'.

updates.summary: Correct swapped Attach operands on Ogre Geargrabber, missing counter-unless payment branch on Hope-Ender Coatl, Ability counter kind on Summary Dismissal, and granted Source reference on Essence Leak.
updates.evidence: Ogre Geargrabber attaches Target(0) (Equipment) to Source (self), not vice versa; Hope-Ender Coatl counters only if the optional {1} payment is not chosen; Summary Dismissal counters 'all abilities' (kind Ability, not Spell); Essence Leak's granted upkeep ability refers to its own holder's mana cost (ManaCostOf(Source), not AttachedTo(Source)).

updates.summary: Preserve active-player turn restrictions on Tifa, Martial Artist and Katara, Water Tribe's Hope.
updates.evidence: Tifa, Martial Artist checks 'if it's the first combat phase of your turn' (requiring PlayerIsActive(AbilityController) alongside Window(FirstCombat)); Katara, Water Tribe's Hope states 'Activate only during your turn' (limits.condition PlayerIsActive(AbilityController), not null).

updates.summary: Use historical WasAttachedTo(Target(0, 0)) after zone change on Fumble and Murderous Spoils.
updates.evidence: Fumble ('Return target creature to its owner's hand. Gain control of all Auras and Equipment that were attached to it, then attach them to another creature.') and Murderous Spoils ('Destroy target nonblack creature. It can't be regenerated. You gain control of all Equipment that were attached to it.') query what was attached to the target creature immediately before it left the battlefield (CR 608.2h). Frozen gold emitted live AttachedTo(SameObject(Target(0, 0))), which is always empty once the target is in hand or graveyard; crates/oracle-ir/src/ir/objects.rs:471 defines ObjectFilter::WasAttachedTo(ObjectRef) specifically as 'Was attached to this object as it last existed' (already used by frozen gold on Hateful Eidolon and Zack Fair).

updates.summary: Use AllSameProperty(Colors) instead of Not(NoCommonProperty(Colors)) on Dead Ringers.
updates.evidence: Dead Ringers reads 'Destroy two target nonblack creatures unless either one is a color the other isn't. They can't be regenerated.' It destroys both targets iff they have the exact same set of colors (AllSameProperty(Colors), defined in crates/oracle-ir/src/ir/selection.rs:322 as 'Every object has the same set of values of this property'). Frozen gold used Not(SubsetMeets{..., constraints:[NoCommonProperty(Colors)]}), which wrongly destroys a mono-red creature and a red-blue creature (they share red, even though the red-blue creature is blue which the red one isn't) and wrongly spares two colorless creatures (they share no colors).

updates.summary: Negate SharesWithAny on Radagast the Brown's 'doesn't share a creature type' filter.
updates.evidence: Radagast the Brown's Oracle text reads: 'You may reveal a creature card that doesn't share a creature type with a creature you control from among those cards and put it into your hand.' Frozen gold (both Triggered abilities) exported positive SharesWithAny without Not(...), inverting the filter to match cards that DO share a creature type. Compare Menagerie Curator and Volo, Guide to Monsters in frozen gold, which both wrap SharesWithAny in Not(...).

updates.summary: Require AbilityController as caster and hand owner on Amped Raptor's 'if you cast it from your hand'.
updates.evidence: Amped Raptor reads: "When this creature enters, you get {E}{E}. Then if you cast it from your hand, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card..." Under CR 109.5, "you" refers to the controller of the ability (AbilityController). Frozen gold exported Cast{by: null, from: Players{zone: Hand, players: One(CasterOf(Candidate))}}, which erroneously drops the 'you cast it' actor check and checks the caster's hand instead of the ability controller's hand (failing when an opponent casts it from their hand and it enters under your control, e.g. via Gather Specimens). All 27 other 'if you cast it from your hand' faces in the allowed corpus (Angel of the Dire Hour, Breaching Leviathan, Coal Stoker, Deathbringer Regent, Dread Cacodemon, Feasting Troll King, etc.) export Cast{by: One(AbilityController), from: Players{zone: Hand, players: One(AbilityController)}}.

updates.summary: Use CountDistinct(..., Names) on Swine Rebellion's 'Boars with different names' conditions.
updates.evidence: Swine Rebellion reads: "If you control three or more Boars with different names, conjure each card from the Three Pigs spellbook onto the battlefield. If you control two or fewer Boars with different names, conjure two cards of your choice from the Three Pigs spellbook into your hand, then put one of them onto the battlefield." Frozen gold exported CountObjects over controlled Boars in both conditions, completely dropping 'with different names' (incorrectly treating three identically named Boars as satisfying 'three or more Boars with different names' and failing 'two or fewer Boars with different names'). All 4 other 'if you control ... with different names' faces in the allowed corpus (Field of the Dead, Liliana's Contract, Maze's End, The Necrobloom) use CountDistinct with property Names.

updates.summary: Use strict Less comparison for Gyrus, Waker of Corpses's 'with lesser power' graveyard target filter.
updates.evidence: Gyrus, Waker of Corpses reads 'you may exile target creature card with lesser power from your graveyard.' Official Gatherer ruling (2018-07-13) confirms the targeted creature card's power must be strictly less than Gyrus's power (Less, not LessOrEqual).

updates.summary: Restore player protection effect on Faith's Shield's fateful hour branch.
updates.evidence: Faith's Shield reads 'If you have 5 or less life, instead you and each permanent you control gain protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.' Frozen MTGish gold omitted the Players(One(AbilityController)) PlayerRule(GrantKeyword(Protection(...))) continuous effect, matching Seht's Tiger and Serra's Emissary.

updates.summary: Exclude Source from Jeweled Bird's 'all other cards you own from the ante' graveyard return filter.
updates.evidence: Jeweled Bird reads '{T}: Ante this artifact. If you do, put all other cards you own from the ante into your graveyard, then draw a card.' Frozen MTGish gold used OwnedBy(One(AbilityController)) without Not(SameObject(Source)), which would return Jeweled Bird itself from ante to the graveyard.

updates.summary: Use NotEqual comparison for Haktos the Unscarred's 'protection from each mana value other than the chosen number'.
updates.evidence: Haktos the Unscarred reads 'Haktos has protection from each mana value other than the chosen number.' Frozen MTGish gold inverted the predicate to Equal (same bug class as U0158).

updates.summary: Reference AttachedTo(Source) rather than destroy result for Orcish Mine's 'that land's controller'.
updates.evidence: Orcish Mine reads 'When the last ore counter is removed from this Aura, destroy enchanted land and this Aura deals 2 damage to that land's controller.' Per CR 608.2c/609.3 and SPEC.md (same bug class as U0156 Ertai Resurrected), damage is still dealt to enchanted land's controller even if destruction fails (indestructible/regenerated); Result(0, Before, 0) would be empty.

updates.summary: Remove spurious ControlledBy(AbilityController) from Jasmine Boreal of the Seven's blocker filter.
updates.evidence: Jasmine Boreal of the Seven reads 'Creatures you control with no abilities can't be blocked by creatures with abilities.' Frozen MTGish gold erroneously copied ControlledBy(One(AbilityController)) into the BeBlocked blocker filter.

updates.summary: Restrict Longhorn Firebeast and Vexing Devil willing-player damage payment to opponents.
updates.evidence: Both Longhorn Firebeast ('any opponent may have it deal 5 damage to them') and Vexing Devil ('any opponent may have it deal 4 damage to them') specify 'any opponent', not 'any player'. Across the corpus all other 'any opponent may' cards use FirstWilling(OpponentsOf(AbilityController)); only these two faces erroneously exported FirstWilling(All).

updates.summary: Represent Mordenkainen's 'Exchange your hand and library, then shuffle' as sequential Exchange then Shuffle instructions.
updates.evidence: Mordenkainen's -10 ability reads 'Exchange your hand and library, then shuffle. You get an emblem with "You have no maximum hand size."' Per CR 608.2c, 'then shuffle' happens sequentially after the zone exchange (matching Morality Shift, which exports sequential [Effect(Exchange), Effect(Shuffle)], not simultaneous Together).

updates.summary: Restore missing negation Not(...) on Wilhelt, the Rotcleaver's 'if it didn't have decayed' intervening-if condition.
updates.evidence: Wilhelt, the Rotcleaver reads: 'Whenever another Zombie you control dies, if it didn't have decayed, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.' Frozen gold emitted `intervening_if: ObjectMatches{object: EventSubject, filter: HasKeywordFamily(Decayed)}` without `Not`, inverting the condition so Wilhelt triggers only when a decayed Zombie dies (going infinite with its own tokens) instead of when a non-decayed Zombie dies. Wrapping the filter in `Not(HasKeywordFamily(Decayed))` restores the exact Oracle meaning.

updates.summary: Apply Ent's Fury's +1/+1 pump to target creature you control (Target slot 0) rather than target creature you don't control (Target slot 1).
updates.evidence: Ent's Fury reads: 'Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control if its power is 4 or greater. Then that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and fights target creature you don't control.' 'That creature' refers unambiguously to Target{slot: 0} (target creature you control). Frozen gold mistakenly set the CreateContinuousEffect's `affected` to `Target{slot: 1, index: 0}`, pumping the opponent's creature before the fight instead of your own creature.

updates.summary: Use a CR 603.12 ReflexiveTrigger for Richlau, Headmaster's 'you may pay {1}. When you do, target artifact card in your graveyard ...' clause.
updates.evidence: Richlau, Headmaster reads: 'At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {1}. When you do, target artifact card in your graveyard perpetually gains "This spell costs {1} less to cast." If it's a creature or Vehicle card, it perpetually gets +2/+2. Put it into your library second from the top.' Under CR 603.12, 'When you do, target ...' creates a reflexive triggered ability whose target is announced only after paying {1}, NOT when the end-step trigger goes on the stack (matching Go-Shintai of Lost Wisdom, Itzquinth, Firstborn of Gishath, and Ty Lee, Artful Acrobat in frozen gold). Frozen gold omitted ReflexiveTrigger and placed the target on the outer end-step trigger's announcement.

updates.summary: Check the exiled payment card's mana value via CostObjects on Summoner's Sending instead of turn-wide exile EventHistory.
updates.evidence: Summoner's Sending reads: 'At the beginning of your end step, you may exile target creature card from a graveyard. If you do, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying. Put a +1/+1 counter on it if the exiled card's mana value is 4 or greater.' Frozen gold encoded 'if the exiled card's mana value is 4 or greater' as `EventHistory{event: ZoneChange{objects: Property{ManaValue >= 4}, to: Exile}, window: ThisTurn, measure: Occurrences} >= 1`, which falsely succeeds if any unrelated card with mana value >= 4 was exiled anywhere that turn even when Summoner's Sending exiled a 1-mana creature. Testing `Query{objects: CostObjects{payment: Resolution(0), component: [0], view: Performed, phase: After}, index: 0}` directly inspects the card exiled by the payment.

updates.summary: Restore missing ControlledBy(One(AbilityController)) predicate on Guild Summit's 'untapped Gates you control' choice.
updates.evidence: Guild Summit reads: 'When this enchantment enters, you may tap any number of untapped Gates you control. Draw a card for each Gate tapped this way.' Frozen gold emitted `filter: AllOf([Not(Tapped), Subtype(Gate)])`, dropping `ControlledBy(One(AbilityController))` and allowing the controller to tap opponents' Gates (same class of dropped controller predicate fixed in U0159).

updates.summary: Restore missing Not(SameObject(Source)) ('other') exclusion on Coalition Construct's perpetual ETB buff.
updates.evidence: Coalition Construct reads: 'As this creature enters, choose a creature type. This creature is the chosen type in addition to its other types. When this creature enters, other creatures you control of the chosen type and creature cards of that type in your hand perpetually get +1/+1.' Frozen gold omitted `Not(SameObject(Source))` from the battlefield perpetual pump filter, causing Coalition Construct (which is itself the chosen creature type via ability 2) to perpetually buff itself, directly contradicting 'other creatures you control of the chosen type'.

updates.summary: Use WhichCreaturesBlock on Berserker's Frenzy's 'You choose which creatures block this turn and how those creatures block' result.
updates.evidence: Berserker's Frenzy's 15-20 result reads verbatim: 'You choose which creatures block this turn and how those creatures block.' In frozen gold, every other card with this exact wording (Master Warcraft, Odric, Master Tactician, and Melee) uses `GameDecision::WhichCreaturesBlock` (allowing the controller to choose which creatures block, including choosing none), whereas `HowCreaturesBlock(filter)` is for cards like Brutal Hordechief ('you choose how those creatures block') that only control blocking assignments. Frozen gold exported `HowCreaturesBlock(CardType(Creature))` on Berserker's Frenzy, losing the 'which creatures block' decision.

updates.summary: Fix inverted Repeat times and Incubate amount on Glistening Dawn.
updates.evidence: Glistening Dawn reads 'Incubate X twice, where X is the number of lands you control.' (CR 701.52: incubate with value X two times, creating two Incubator tokens each with X +1/+1 counters). Frozen MTGish gold inverted the operands as Repeat{times: CountObjects(lands you control), body: Incubate{amount: Constant(2)}} (creating X tokens with 2 counters each) instead of Repeat{times: Constant(2), body: Incubate{amount: CountObjects(lands you control)}}.

updates.summary: Use Affected instead of Source in Earnest Fellowship's SharesColorWith protection grant.
updates.evidence: Earnest Fellowship reads: 'Each creature has protection from each of its colors.' Under CR 702.16, 'each of its colors' refers to each affected creature's own colors (SharesColorWith(Affected), matching Tam, Mindful First-Year's 'has hexproof from each of its colors' grant in continuous.ebnf). Frozen MTGish gold emitted SharesColorWith(Source), which grants every creature protection from Earnest Fellowship's color (white) instead of each creature's own colors.

updates.summary: Bind Dance of Many's two token references to its linked creating ability.
updates.evidence: Issue #20 follow-up https://github.com/vishvananda/oracle-grammar/issues/20#issuecomment-6934199376; CR 607.2c and 607.5. Both the token-removal instruction and token-leaves trigger refer to tokens created by the linked creating text and its exact acquisition on this source incarnation. CreatedWith(Source) preserves that identity; generic MadeBy(Source) also admits unrelated granted abilities and separate acquisitions. Preserve Token, Source and every other operand. The schema-192 owned contract already defines this relation; no model change or source-text rewrite is needed.

updates.summary: Combine Frankenstein's Monster's nested matching filters without changing its exile receipt.
updates.evidence: Issue #33 follow-up https://github.com/vishvananda/oracle-grammar/issues/33#issuecomment-6934200147. Matching(Matching(S,A),B) and Matching(S,AllOf([A,B])) evaluate the same pure predicates on the same candidate and object view. Preserve Transition(result=1, After), the creature predicate and the Exile arrival guard. This combines predicates only; it does not remove zone qualifications or equate a recorded arrival with current zone membership. The owned canonical reduction is bounded to 64 conjuncts, preserves typed-ID origins and leaves authored print nesting intact.

updates.summary: Use actual death outcomes and simultaneous distinct returns for Glyph of Reincarnation.
updates.evidence: Issue #36. CR 700.4 defines dying as battlefield-to-graveyard movement. Record both zones on the destroy receipt before projecting Before identities for historical controller lookup. CR 608.2d restricts legal return choices; reserve distinct identities across the object loop and move the gathered selection once, simultaneously. Spell controller chooses; the last-blocking controller identifies the graveyard; each returned card enters under its owner. Replacement redirection and later movement never become live membership tests.

updates.summary: Register delayed prevention counters once and capture cumulative shield receipts.
updates.evidence: Issue #35. The original Oracle sentences register one delayed trigger when the spell resolves, independently of whether the shield ever prevents damage. Only ModifyEvent(PreventDamage) belongs in the callback. The delayed counter amount captures that exact instantiated shield and reads its lifetime prevention total, including zero or multiple events. Preserve the original recipient and creature condition. Performed remains an event-local receipt; PerformedTotal remains a loop aggregate.

updates.summary: Represent North Star as one limited mana-cost spending permission.
updates.evidence: Issue #34. The original Oracle wording grants a chosen spending substitution for one spell mana cost this turn. It gives no casting action, zone permission, timing exception, discount or alternative cost. Preserve the affected controller and duration. The permission has its own positive remaining-use count and applies only to the mana-cost component of eligible spells, from any otherwise legal zone. Additional and alternative costs retain normal rules.

updates.summary: Require the selected card to arrive in exile before Break Expectations drafts and reveals a card.
updates.evidence: Issue #37, https://github.com/vishvananda/oracle-grammar/issues/37. Oracle requires that the selected card was exiled this way. Match the actual Exile arrival in the After view of the move receipt, as on Corpse Appraiser in U0087. Retain U0125, which reveals Recorded(3) from the draft.

updates.summary: Offer every integer in the written range on Shapeshifter and the five other faces using the same literal choice.
updates.evidence: Issue #38, https://github.com/vishvananda/oracle-grammar/issues/38. Both of Shapeshifter’s printed 0–7 options include all eight values. The same grammar production on five other allowed faces also encoded only the endpoints. Expand the written inclusive ranges. Preserve each chooser, optionality, any cost or effect scope, and the U0030 characteristic-defining ability.

updates.summary: Support on a permanent cannot target the permanent itself.
updates.evidence: The original Oracle reminder prints “other” on the creature sources. Support on any permanent carries the same source exclusion, including Together Forever, Captured by Lagacs and Blitzball Stadium if they become creatures. Instant and sorcery support keeps the unqualified creature target. See Wizards of the Coast, Modern Horizons 3 Mechanics, https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/modern-horizons-3-mechanics#support. Retain counts and target slots, including Blitzball Stadium’s entry spell X.

updates.summary: Keep explicit starting intensity zero on seven Alchemy faces.
updates.evidence: The original Oracle text in the frozen allowed faces begins 'Starting intensity 0' on all seven faces. The pinned reference retains StartingIntensity for positive declarations but drops these explicit zero declarations. Restore the printed amount and restore Minthara of the Absolute's printed order, placing the static pump before its once-per-turn trigger. Wizards describes intensity as a designation with an initial value at https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/mtg-arena/mtg-arena-state-game-alchemy-kamigawa-2022-03-16.

updates.summary: Require as many cards as possible up to three for Earwig Squad’s unqualified library search.
updates.evidence: Earwig Squad says to search target opponent's library for three cards. The instruction specifies a number with no quality and does not say up to. The search must find three if available and as many as possible otherwise. See the official Opposition Agent clarification at https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/spider-man-release-notes.

updates.summary: Definite linked exile returns include every card exiled by the linked ability.
updates.evidence: CR 607.3 applies actions on “the exiled card” to each linked card when more than one was exiled. The Lorwyn Eclipsed release notes explicitly confirm that Tidehollow Sculler returns both linked cards when a copy of its entry trigger exiled another card. CR 607.2q links the behold-and-exile payment to the permanent that resulted from that spell. See https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/lorwyn-eclipsed-release-notes and https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt.

updates.summary: Gix's successful life-payment branch draws for the player who paid.
updates.evidence: The trigger offers the damage source's controller the payment. The two pronouns in “If they do, they draw a card” refer to the same player. Record the payment's performer and use that actor in the positive branch, as stated in the official release notes, https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/the-brothers-war-release-notes.

updates.summary: Characteristic tests after a return to a hidden hand read the card’s last known public state.
updates.evidence: CR 608.2h specifically uses last known information if a resolving effect moves the object from a public zone to a hidden zone. Tamiyo, Jared, and Giant Regrowth test a specific card returned from a graveyard to its owner’s hand. Keep the actual movement result and inspect its Before snapshot. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Reckless Crew chooses the equipment assignments and then attaches them simultaneously.
updates.evidence: The Kaldheim release notes say the selected Equipment all become attached simultaneously. The Phyrexia: All Will Be One release notes confirm the same wording on Goldwardens’ Gambit chooses all assignments before attaching and cannot reuse one Equipment across hosts. See https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/kaldheim-release-notes-2021-01-22 and https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/phyrexia-all-will-be-one-release-notes.

updates.summary: An optional exile followed by an immediate return uses one optional action and its actual movement receipt.
updates.evidence: CR 118.12 describes a resolving cost when a later “if you do” tests the decision. These abilities use “you may exile …, then return,” without a payment check. CR 400.7 permits the same effect to find the cards it actually moved to exile. Preserve the whole actual After transition and its exile-zone restriction, and keep the written return controller. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Demolition Field allows the original land’s controller to search when the land survives.
updates.evidence: Wizards’ Foundations release notes specify that the land’s controller can search even when the targeted land has indestructible. A performed destruction receipt can be empty in that case. The targeted land supplies the controller for the optional decision, search, arrival and shuffle. CR 608.2h preserves the target’s last-known controller if it does leave. https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/foundations-release-notes

updates.summary: Splinter compares names with the targeted artifact as it existed on the battlefield.
updates.evidence: CR 109.2 places an unqualified artifact on the battlefield. CR 608.2h reads the specific object’s current or last-known information in its expected public zone. “That artifact” identifies the original target, whose battlefield name may differ from the name of the card in exile, for example if the permanent was a copy. Its controller still owns the search and shuffle. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: One written entry trigger shares a body across its two triggering events.
updates.evidence: CR 603.1 assigns a trigger condition and an effect to the one written “Whenever” ability. CR 113.2c identifies separate abilities by paragraph breaks. These cards share one instruction that applies to the entering creature, sourced from the ability’s card. Preserve both disjoint entry events and the same subject, amount, duration, and creator. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: The shuffle targets on Perpetual Timepiece and The Bath Song come from the ability controller's graveyard.
updates.evidence: Both faces say “target cards from your graveyard.” CR 109.5 determines whose graveyard “your” names, and CR 115.1 makes the written zone and player restriction part of target eligibility. The bare Graveyard domain matches every player's graveyard. The added InZone filter supplies precisely the written player.

updates.summary: Each token created by Chainer's Torment deals the captured X damage.
updates.evidence: The Dominaria Release Notes state that when a replacement such as Anointed Procession adds another token, each created Nightmare Horror deals X damage. They also say that a change to the token's power or toughness leaves the damage at X. Keep the existing BindValue and use the full Created result as the simultaneous damage sources. https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/dominaria-release-notes

updates.summary: The Scarab God uses one Zombie count for life loss and scry.
updates.evidence: The printed where-clause defines one X for both instructions. The Hour of Devastation Release Notes say the count is taken as the ability resolves and use that same count for the life loss and scry in Two-Headed Giant. Capturing X preserves that value through any changes made by replacements during the first instruction. https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/hour-of-devastation-release-notes-2017-06-30

updates.summary: Rampage of the Valkyries exempts the resolving ability's controller.
updates.evidence: The trigger condition refers to an Angel you control and the resulting sacrifice applies to each other player. CR 109.5 gives you its controller relative to that ability. CR 707.10 allows a copy of that trigger to have a different controller while keeping its original event, so the dead Angel's controller cannot stand in for the resolving ability's controller. The Kaldheim Release Notes describe the choice order relative to you as the ability resolves. https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/kaldheim-release-notes-2021-01-22

updates.summary: Militant Angel counts the opponents attacked during the turn, including opponents who later left the game.
updates.evidence: The Oracle text counts the number of opponents you attacked this turn. The Star Trek Release Notes clarify that opponents who leave the game later still count for this same wording, and that attacks on only a planeswalker or battle do not count. The italicized Battlefront ability word does not change those instructions (CR 207.2c). Use the historical opponent set in place of an intersection with the current opponents. https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/star-trek-release-notes#new-ability-word-battlefront

updates.summary: Keep delayed end-of-combat triggers pending if their trigger step is skipped.
updates.evidence: The Oracle text says at end of combat. CR 511.2 distinguishes the beginning of the end of combat step from a duration that expires when the combat phase ends. CR 725.2d–e makes that distinction observable when an effect ends combat before that step. The delayed ability has no written expiry and triggers only at its first eligible occurrence under CR 603.7b. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Group the simultaneous combat damage to one or more players as one trigger occurrence.
updates.evidence: Forth Eorlingas! specifies one or more creatures and one or more players in one damage match. Under CR 603.2c each occurrence of this whole trigger event produces one instance, including when multiple players take combat damage simultaneously. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Use the targeted permanent to identify the controller who creates the Powerstone.
updates.evidence: Cityscape Leveler instructs the targeted permanent’s controller to create a Powerstone in a separate sentence, without testing whether the permanent was destroyed. A legal indestructible target may remain on the battlefield and the controller still creates the token (CR 101.3, 608.2b–c and 702.12). The target reads the current or applicable last known controller rather than a performed-destruction receipt. https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/the-brothers-war-release-notes https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Schedule Aleatory’s delayed draw regardless of the coin flip.
updates.evidence: Aleatory puts the delayed draw in its own Oracle paragraph. “If you win the flip” governs only the preceding paragraph’s targeted power and toughness change. The spell follows its instructions in written order under CR 608.2c. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Announce one target from the written union of spells and applicable permanents.
updates.evidence: The printed target is a spell or a permanent meeting its own restrictions. CR 112.1, 112.1a and 113.1 distinguish a spell (including a spell copy) from an ability on the stack. CR 110.1 limits permanents to the battlefield. CR 601.2b–c distinguishes choosing written modes from choosing a target. Jeskai Revelation and Sink into Stupor each use one union target; Brutal Expulsion retains its explicitly written modes. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/tarkir-dragonstorm-release-notes https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/modern-horizons-3-release-notes

updates.summary: Apply the explicitly written creature card type during animation.
updates.evidence: Arlinn becomes a Werewolf creature and loses the planeswalker card type per the official release notes. Roaring Earth and Waker of the Wilds both make the target land a creature while retaining its land type. CR 205.1a–b distinguishes replacing card types from retaining them as a type is added. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/innistrad-midnight-hunt-release-notes

updates.summary: Test for a card still in this source’s linked exile zone.
updates.evidence: Redemptor Dreadnought says “if a card is exiled with it” as an attack trigger’s intervening condition. CR 603.4 checks the condition at triggering and resolution, and CR 607.2a and 607.2e tie the cards to this linked exile cost. Unrelated or previously exiled cards do not satisfy the test. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Have the exiled object deal damage using its own power in exile.
updates.evidence: Selfless Exorcist names “that card” directly after moving it to public exile. Under CR 400.7j the later part of the same effect can find the new object, and CR 608.2h uses current information when the referenced object is in the expected public zone. The damage source and the measured object both name the actual face-up exile result. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Let Put Away decline the shuffle when it resolves.
updates.evidence: Put Away chooses up to one graveyard target while being cast (CR 601.2c). Its separate “you may” gives the resolving spell’s controller a choice under CR 608.2d even when a legal target was chosen. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Use a constant for the written third position.
updates.evidence: Shattered Ego explicitly says “third from the top.” Constant(3) is the exact same integral position as Add(Constant(2), Constant(1)) and uses the same ordinal representation as the ordinary library-movement grammar.

updates.summary: Use the same resolving choice for each indefinite opponent control transfer.
updates.evidence: Each written “an opponent gains control” names one opponent of the ability controller, chosen at resolution under CR 608.2d. The existing GiveControl operation preserves its live eligible population and snapshots one chosen controller onto the stated object. The four obsolete explicit choices had no subsequent reader. https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/foundations-release-notes

updates.summary: Use the existing other-player set for permanents you do not control.
updates.evidence: Lagoon Breach tests that the controller of the targeted permanent is a player other than the spell’s controller. The bound complement of One(AbilityController) is exactly OthersThan(AbilityController). The separate owner remains the player who chooses the library position.

updates.summary: Use the written resolution choice to cast spells from hand.
updates.evidence: Aetherflux Conduit, Power Without Equal and Yahenni's Expertise each say “you may cast.” Preserve that choice independently of the count of spells cast when the offer is accepted. The cast occurs while the offering ability or spell is resolving (CR 608.2d, 608.2g). https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: Use the live end-of-turn blocking prohibition for both thresholds.
updates.evidence: Barrage of Boulders and Demoralize prohibit creature blocks for the rest of the turn when their conditions hold. This changes the rules of the game and applies to creatures that enter or change type later that turn (CR 611.2a, 611.2c). https://media.wizards.com/2026/downloads/MagicCompRules%2020261106.txt

updates.summary: The targeted land's controller chooses whether to search.
updates.evidence: White Orchid Phantom gives the legal target's controller a search choice even if the land is indestructible. If the player declines, they do not search or shuffle. The controller comes from the announced target, and the choice governs the search, move, and shuffle. https://media.wizards.com/2024/downloads/MH3_Release_Notes_9d01wihakukg/EN_MTGMH3_ReleaseNotes_20240515.pdf

updates.summary: Use the singleton transition for exile permissions tied to retaining control.
updates.evidence: Gwen Stacy and Lightning, Security Sergeant move the one top card of their controller’s library. At most one card can result from each move. The permission to play that card while still controlling the source therefore covers precisely the movement’s After transition, as in Victor Mancha, Runaway. The duration, player and originating move stay the same.
